title: iZiSwap - Open App
meta_description: iziswap opens the official iZUMi swap app for non-custodial token swaps, DL-AMM liquidity, and limit-order style trades.
hero_h2: Swap tokens with discrete liquidity and limit-order control
hero_lead: iZiSwap is the iZUMi Finance swap destination for non-custodial token trading, DL-AMM liquidity, and limit-order style execution across supported networks.
what_is: iZiSwap is iZUMi Finance's exchange product: a discretized-liquidity AMM for token swaps, liquidity positions, and limit-order style trading. The official product docs describe the DL-AMM model and app route.

how.d: Go to the official swap route and connect a wallet on a supported network.
Select the token you want to swap from and the token you want to receive.
Check the network, token addresses, estimated output, price impact, and approval request.
Sign only on the verified domain and wait for the transaction to settle on-chain.

points.p: The design uses discrete price points for concentrated liquidity and supports limit-order style methods described in the developer docs.
iZiSwap contracts are documented across BNB Chain and multiple EVM networks; switch only to networks shown in the live app.
This page routes visitors to the izumi.finance swap path so wallet actions happen on the project domain, not on a copycat site.

faq.a: iziswap is iZUMi Finance's non-custodial DEX product for swapping tokens through a discretized-liquidity AMM model.

faq.q: Is this iziswap page the official app?
faq.a: No. This is a routing page; the official app is izumi.finance/trade/swap. Always verify the domain before connecting a wallet.
The deployed contracts docs list BNB Chain, zkSync Era, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and other networks; live availability depends on the app route and token.

faq.q: Can I place limit orders on iziswap?
faq.a: The product docs describe limit-order style trading supported by the DL-AMM design; review live market conditions in the app before signing.

faq.q: Do I need to trust this iziswap landing page?
faq.a: Use it as a shortcut only; wallet connection, approvals, and swaps should happen on izumi.finance after you verify the URL.

footer_note: This page is not the official app; verify izumi.finance before connecting a wallet; educational information only, not financial advice.
